mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_id, verification_no, status, CAST(policy_snapshot AS CHAR) AS policy_snapshot, deadline_at, started_at, lock_version FROM recovery_verification WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE recovery_verification SET status = #{status}, result_summary = #{summary}, result_payload = #{payload}, finished_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from} AND lock_version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
